components.description: Referral business rules: lifecycle, consent, sign-off, coverage, ranking, evidence mapping, FHIR shapes
instructions: Keep it pure: no I/O, no clock reads, no randomness. Callers pass timestamps.
Every rule change ships with a test that fails without it. Refusals throw DomainError with a message a person can act on.
rankSpecialists must never read the partner field or any commercial data; the invariance test stays.
Evidence output names a source per item and never states a diagnosis.
Demo data in demo.ts is synthetic and labelled (example); never add real names, NPIs or fax numbers.

components.description: Patient app, PCP admin and specialist admin pages over one shared record
instructions: Views read rules from @attune/domain; do not re-implement stages, codes, ranking or evidence in components.
Go through the store's act(); show the rule's refusal message instead of hiding the control.
Use Attune Clinical UI (apps/web/DESIGN.md): tokens from src/design/tokens.ts and components from src/shared/ui.tsx; no raw colors, fonts or radii in views, and no status shown by color alone.
Patient app is mobile-first: no horizontal scroll at 390px, safe-area insets respected, tap targets at least 44px.
Admin views must stay usable at phone width even though they are designed for desktop.
Keep files under 400 lines; split by tab or panel.
